tasks.description: Derive exact stage-local Schur condensation of a178838-coordinate full-mass PN system, retaining nonlinear channels and reconstructing passive variables without removing dynamic modes; same SDIRK stages and full residual tolerance.
Implement and compare a CPU compiled coupled PN step and a GPU elimination feasibility screen against actual captured linear and full-step inputs; preserve state, calcium chemistry and clocks.
Independently examine commit-pinned PN condensation and comparison code, looking for changes of equations, acceptance thresholds, resource limits or unsupported whole-organism speed claims.
